[[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] '''Bennings''' was an individual who served aboard the [[Thaereian military]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Stark Wing]]'' during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bennings was aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] when it traveled to the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], and was possessed by a [[Oblee|shadow lurker]], causing the corporal speak about how the Thaereians should evacuate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
